title: Enter the teaching as given
summary: Even the doorway into the teaching is received, not self-composed. Return the tired body to refuge before asking more of it.
takeaway: Return the tired body to refuge before asking more of it.
lifeApplication: When force is failing, stop performing strength, sit down, and let one line carry the next breath.

source.shortMeaning: Even the doorway into the teaching is received, not self-composed.
source.lifeApplication: Before beginning, receive the path as given instead of improvising yourself into it.

evidence.coreClaim: Even the doorway into the teaching is received, not self-composed.
evidence.turn: Place the mind's trust in the Guru as cooling shelter.
